name: Rack It Up 2026: 48-Hour Online Hackathon by Rack'Em

details.title: Round 1: Registration & Team Formation
details.display_text:
• Register on Unstop and build your team of 1 to 4 members (solo is welcome, and cross-college and cross-city teams are allowed).
  • Registrations close on 9 Dec, 11:59 PM IST.
  • Updates come by email, and live mentor hours run on Zoom. Sponsor problem statements and prize amounts are announced between 2 and 5 Dec.

details.title: Round 2: The Hack (48 hours)
details.display_text:
• Build and deploy your project in 48 hours, from Fri 11 Dec 6 PM to Sun 13 Dec 6 PM IST. Submit on Unstop before the deadline: your project name and theme, a live deployed link (any hosting is fine), your public code repository, and a demo video of up to 3 minutes.
  • Mentor hours run live on Zoom during the hack.

details.title: Round 3: Finals (Top 10 live demos)
details.display_text:
• The top 10 teams from Round 2 demo their live projects to the judges and sponsors on Zoom on Mon 14 Dec.
  • Shortlisted teams get the schedule and Zoom link by email. Results are announced on Tue 15 Dec.
